lore11317_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You know when I am angling for a favor, and you still come back just to talk. I appreciate that. Today, let us enjoy the company. I promise there is no bucket waiting at the end.
lore11317_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know when I am angling for a favor, and you still come back just to talk. I appreciate that. Today, let us enjoy the company. I promise there is no bucket waiting at the end.

lore11317_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easygoing] [wry] A little walk, you say? I will come along. But if this becomes hauling crates or diving for something, we should discuss the arrangement again. I like to know when a pleasant outing turns into work.
lore11317_greet_1.ogg.text: A little walk, you say? I will come along. But if this becomes hauling crates or diving for something, we should discuss the arrangement again. I like to know when a pleasant outing turns into work.

lore11317_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [unhurried] I moved my seat to find better shade. Then I moved it again. By the time I found the perfect spot, most of the morning had gone. A successful plan. I refuse to hear otherwise.
lore11317_idle_1.ogg.text: I moved my seat to find better shade. Then I moved it again. By the time I found the perfect spot, most of the morning had gone. A successful plan. I refuse to hear otherwise.

lore11317_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed] [pleased] This looks like a fine place to stop. We should test it properly before deciding to move on. A few quiet minutes, perhaps. Longer, if the conversation is good and the sun keeps its distance.
lore11317_rest_1.ogg.text: This looks like a fine place to stop. We should test it properly before deciding to move on. A few quiet minutes, perhaps. Longer, if the conversation is good and the sun keeps its distance.

lore2703_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [gently amused] You have shown me care as well as strength, and I trust both. Come along, friend. A difficult purpose is easier to carry with someone who understands why the small things matter. If I check my pouch once more before we leave, give me a moment. I may also be remembering something I wanted to tell you.
lore2703_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have shown me care as well as strength, and I trust both. Come along, friend. A difficult purpose is easier to carry with someone who understands why the small things matter. If I check my pouch once more before we leave, give me a moment. I may also be remembering something I wanted to tell you.

lore2703_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [purposeful] [welcoming] Welcome, friend. Have you come to help with the work before us? Vol'jin has given me a task that will need careful hands as well as strength. Trol'kalar lies behind protections we must gather the means to open. A missing piece will not become less important because the purpose behind it is great. We begin by paying attention.
lore2703_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Have you come to help with the work before us? Vol'jin has given me a task that will need careful hands as well as strength. Trol'kalar lies behind protections we must gather the means to open. A missing piece will not become less important because the purpose behind it is great. We begin by paying attention.

lore2703_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [conversational] [warm] I explain how much depends on gathering every sigil, then find myself counting the ordinary things in my pouch before leaving. Twice, sometimes. It is a useful habit. Less useful when someone notices that I have just told them I am ready. Give me a moment, friend. I would rather be thorough than return for something small.
lore2703_idle_1.ogg.text: I explain how much depends on gathering every sigil, then find myself counting the ordinary things in my pouch before leaving. Twice, sometimes. It is a useful habit. lore2703_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [instructive] [serious] [steady] When you gather the fragments of the broken sigil, take them to Tor'gan. His skill can make them whole again. Do not mistake the pieces for something already ready to use, or a warded tomb for a chest left open. We need the protections answered properly if Trol'kalar is to serve the purpose Vol'jin has given us.
lore2703_quest_1.ogg.text: When you gather the fragments of the broken sigil, take them to Tor'gan. His skill can make them whole again. Do not mistake the pieces for something already ready to use, or a warded tomb for a chest left open. We need the protections answered properly if Trol'kalar is to serve the purpose Vol'jin has given us.

lore2706_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [hopeful] You have become someone I am glad to have beside me when an answer does not come easily. Come along, friend. I value your willingness to think, to try, and to return when the first attempt has disappointed us. There is room for laughter as well. If my joke ends differently this time, perhaps we will discover the better version together.
lore2706_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am glad to have beside me when an answer does not come easily. Come along, friend. I value your willingness to think, to try, and to return when the first attempt has disappointed us. There is room for laughter as well. If my joke ends differently this time, perhaps we will discover the better version together.

lore2706_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [resolute] [thoughtful] Welcome, friend. There is still hope here, even among the remains of this old prison. Sometimes it takes more than a story to help someone feel it. Sometimes the first attempt fails. I will think again before I abandon the effort. If you have come to help, let us consider what we can try next.
lore2706_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. There is still hope here, even among the remains of this old prison. Sometimes it takes more than a story to help someone feel it. Sometimes the first attempt fails. I will think again before I abandon the effort. If you have come to help, let us consider what we can try next.

lore2706_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [conversational] [warm] I remember telling a joke that made someone laugh until I began laughing too. A good result. Unfortunately, I no longer remember the ending that earned it. I have tried several possibilities since then. Some have been very doubtful. Still, one person laughed at my attempt to explain the problem. Perhaps that is another ending worth keeping.
lore2706_idle_1.ogg.text: I remember telling a joke that made someone laugh until I began laughing too. A good result. Unfortunately, I no longer remember the ending that earned it. I have tried several possibilities since then. Some have been very doubtful. Still, one person laughed at my attempt to explain the problem. Perhaps that is another ending worth keeping.

lore2706_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [concerned] [earnest] [measured] My brother Tan'jani was always searching for something. A traveler brought word of him from south of Loch Modan. Later came a bloodstained letter, with Riverglades and Rog'mar among the few things I could read. I do not know the rest. If you can find him, bring care to the search. A fragment of news leaves much unanswered.
lore2706_quest_1.ogg.text: My brother Tan'jani was always searching for something. A traveler brought word of him from south of Loch Modan. lore3184_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] You have made these quiet days more pleasant. I would like to come along for a while, my friend. Save me a little room when you stop to rest.
lore3184_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made these quiet days more pleasant. I would like to come along for a while, my friend. Save me a little room when you stop to rest.

lore3184_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed] [warm] Ah, there you are. Let me put the stopper in this bottle. Good. Whatever we do today, we can begin without rushing.
lore3184_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, there you are. Let me put the stopper in this bottle. Good. Whatever we do today, we can begin without rushing.

lore3184_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [easygoing] That little cork bird has the right idea. No errands, no battles, and nothing to do but sit comfortably on a shelf.
lore3184_idle_1.ogg.text: That little cork bird has the right idea. No errands, no battles, and nothing to do but sit comfortably on a shelf.

lore3184_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging] [patient] There you are. Your hands found the motion once you stopped fighting it. Give yourself time with the next lesson, too. You do not need to master everything before supper.
lore3184_learned_1.ogg.text: There you are. Your hands found the motion once you stopped fighting it. Give yourself time with the next lesson, too. You do not need to master everything before supper.

lore3188_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gentle pleasure, calm companionship] I would be glad to walk with you. We can speak along the way, and leave some quiet between the words. Tell me what you have noticed. A familiar path may still have something to show us when we share it with a friend.
lore3188_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to walk with you. We can speak along the way, and leave some quiet between the words. Tell me what you have noticed. A familiar path may still have something to show us when we share it with a friend.

lore3188_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm elder welcome, thoughtful patience, grounded] You found me. Come, sit a moment and tell me how the day has been. There is room for a difficult thought, or a small pleasant one. We need not hurry either of them away before you have finished speaking.
lore3188_greet_1.ogg.text: You found me. Come, sit a moment and tell me how the day has been. There is room for a difficult thought, or a small pleasant one. We need not hurry either of them away before you have finished speaking.

lore3188_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet reflective warmth, gently amused, unhurried] This shell is only a shell. Smooth beneath the thumb, a pleasing shape to turn in the hand. Sometimes that is enough to help a thought settle. I listen better when I leave a little space before the answer.
lore3188_idle_1.ogg.text: This shell is only a shell. Smooth beneath the thumb, a pleasing shape to turn in the hand. Sometimes that is enough to help a thought settle. I listen better when I leave a little space before the answer.

lore3188_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [deep patient reassurance, warm elder affection] Here is a place to sit. Let your hands rest for a moment. You need not bring me a question every time we meet. Your company is welcome too. We can watch the light move, and speak when there is something we wish to say.
lore3188_rest_1.ogg.text: Here is a place to sit. Let your hands rest for a moment. You need not bring me a question every time we meet. Your company is welcome too. We can watch the light move, and speak when there is something we wish to say.

lore3287_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere relief, grateful, quietly hopeful] I would like your company. You need not find the right words for everything. Tell me what you can see from here, or sit quietly beside me. It helps to have a friend who sees more than the trouble I am in.
lore3287_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would like your company. You need not find the right words for everything. Tell me what you can see from here, or sit quietly beside me. It helps to have a friend who sees more than the trouble I am in.

lore3287_comforted_1.ogg.spoken: [deeply grateful, vulnerable, renewed resolve] Thank you. I have spent enough time imagining what people would say of me. You came close enough to ask how I was. That means more than a speech about bravery. I will hold on to that kindness when fear starts talking again.
lore3287_comforted_1.ogg.text: Thank you. I have spent enough time imagining what people would say of me. You came close enough to ask how I was. That means more than a speech about bravery. I will hold on to that kindness when fear starts talking again.

lore3287_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weary but hopeful, vulnerable warmth, gentle invitation] You stopped. I am glad. There is a little ant near my hand carrying something far too big for it. I have been quietly taking its side. Sit a moment, if you can. I would welcome someone taking mine as well.
lore3287_greet_1.ogg.text: You stopped. I am glad. There is a little ant near my hand carrying something far too big for it. I have been quietly taking its side. Sit a moment, if you can. I would welcome someone taking mine as well.

lore3287_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [observant, quietly amused, gathering hope] There. It dropped the crumb again. Wait before you laugh. It is going around the other side to try a different grip. I like that. A poor beginning need not decide the whole journey. I am trying to remember it myself.
lore3287_idle_1.ogg.text: There. It dropped the crumb again. Wait before you laugh. It is going around the other side to try a different grip. I like that. A poor beginning need not decide the whole journey. I am trying to remember it myself.

lore3304_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered] [reserved warmth] You have shown patience, and you can admit learning something without dressing it as a triumph. I find your company agreeable. Come along. This is no apprenticeship. We may simply see what the day teaches us, then argue over which lesson was worth remembering.
lore3304_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have shown patience, and you can admit learning something without dressing it as a triumph. I find your company agreeable. Come along. This is no apprenticeship. We may simply see what the day teaches us, then argue over which lesson was worth remembering.

lore3304_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered] [dry] [patient] There you are. Tell me what you learned on the way. Something useful, if you can manage it. I hear enough speeches from people convinced they are ready for an apprenticeship. A small mistake honestly understood may tell me more than all their claims together.
lore3304_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Tell me what you learned on the way. Something useful, if you can manage it. I hear enough speeches from people convinced they are ready for an apprenticeship. A small mistake honestly understood may tell me more than all their claims together.

lore3304_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered] [wry] [quietly amused] A visitor once told me a journey had taught them to keep sand out of their cup. No heroic speech, no great revelation. I laughed. Then the wind filled my own cup, and I found the lesson had arrived exactly when it was needed.
lore3304_idle_1.ogg.text: A visitor once told me a journey had taught them to keep sand out of their cup. No heroic speech, no great revelation. I laughed. Then the wind filled my own cup, and I found the lesson had arrived exactly when it was needed.

lore3304_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered] [firm] [concerned] Pal'juh has promise. Promise does not make going into danger alone a wise decision. I am grateful when someone brings her safely out of trouble. I would be more pleased if she learned enough from the journey not to need the same rescue again.
lore3304_quest_1.ogg.text: Pal'juh has promise. Promise does not make going into danger alone a wise decision. I am grateful when someone brings her safely out of trouble. I would be more pleased if she learned enough from the journey not to need the same rescue again.

lore3400_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You listen when I talk about food, and you bring more to the conversation than a shopping list. I like that. Come along, friend. We will see what the road offers. If we find something good to eat, you may enjoy it without proving anything at all to me.
lore3400_befriended_1.ogg.text: You listen when I talk about food, and you bring more to the conversation than a shopping list. I like that. Come along, friend. We will see what the road offers. If we find something good to eat, you may enjoy it without proving anything at all to me.

lore3400_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [welcoming] [playful] Come, tell me what you plan to cook. I have spices, supplies, and a little advice if you want it. Taste before you add more. You might find the meal was already saying something worth hearing before you invited every seasoning on the shelf to speak over it.
lore3400_greet_1.ogg.text: Come, tell me what you plan to cook. I have spices, supplies, and a little advice if you want it. Taste before you add more. You might find the meal was already saying something worth hearing before you invited every seasoning on the shelf to speak over it.

lore3400_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [conversational] [amused] I once tried to improve a meal with a little of every seasoning I could reach. By the end, I could not have told you what I had cooked. Ate an apple afterward. Best thing I had tasted all evening. That was a useful lesson, though I preferred the apple.
lore3400_idle_1.ogg.text: I once tried to improve a meal with a little of every seasoning I could reach. By the end, I could not have told you what I had cooked. Ate an apple afterward. Best thing I had tasted all evening. That was a useful lesson, though I preferred the apple.

lore3400_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed] [warm] [gently amused] Now we can enjoy a meal without hurrying toward the next thing. Take a bite before you decide what is missing. Sometimes the cook has already done enough. Sometimes an apple needs nothing at all. Either way, I would rather hear that you enjoyed it than that you survived it.
lore3400_rest_1.ogg.text: Now we can enjoy a meal without hurrying toward the next thing. Take a bite before you decide what is missing. Sometimes the cook has already done enough. lore3401_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [restrained warmth] You have become someone whose company I choose, rather than someone awaiting instruction. That is a useful distinction, my friend. Let us have a little time together without a mission attached.
lore3401_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone whose company I choose, rather than someone awaiting instruction. That is a useful distinction, my friend. Let us have a little time together without a mission attached.

lore3401_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured] [dry warmth] There you are. We can walk together for a while. Pay attention to what is around you, but you need not report every observation. I am allowing myself a little company.
lore3401_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. We can walk together for a while. Pay attention to what is around you, but you need not report every observation. I am allowing myself a little company.

lore3401_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [quietly amused] Yes, that was a crunch. The wrapping has already been dealt with. I have decided that a pleasant bite between lessons need not become another exercise in stealth.
lore3401_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, that was a crunch. The wrapping has already been dealt with. I have decided that a pleasant bite between lessons need not become another exercise in stealth.

lore3401_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [approving] You watched, understood, and then acted. Keep that order in mind. A lesson practiced carefully here may spare you a much less forgiving correction when you are in the field.
lore3401_learned_1.ogg.text: You watched, understood, and then acted. Keep that order in mind. A lesson practiced carefully here may spare you a much less forgiving correction when you are in the field.

lore3482_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical] [amused] Before you force anything else into that bag, check the dye and the vials. It is easier to pack carefully now than explain afterward why every useful thing has turned blue.
lore3482_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Before you force anything else into that bag, check the dye and the vials. It is easier to pack carefully now than explain afterward why every useful thing has turned blue.

lore3482_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] I enjoy seeing you even when you need nothing from the shelves. Let us spend a little time together, my friend. We can find something to talk about besides supplies.
lore3482_befriended_1.ogg.text: I enjoy seeing you even when you need nothing from the shelves. Let us spend a little time together, my friend. We can find something to talk about besides supplies.

lore3482_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly] [lightly teasing] There you are. Have you packed what you need, or are we going to discover the missing tool halfway down the road? Either way, I am glad for the company.
lore3482_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Have you packed what you need, or are we going to discover the missing tool halfway down the road? Either way, I am glad for the company.

lore3482_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [easygoing] Selling hot spices does not oblige me to put them in every meal. I like to taste my supper. You may call that sensible, and I will happily agree.
lore3482_idle_1.ogg.text: Selling hot spices does not oblige me to put them in every meal. I like to taste my supper. You may call that sensible, and I will happily agree.

lore3490_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [encouraging] Make a little room before the grand departure. A bag full of impressive finds can still be missing the small thing you meant to bring. I am happy to supply a suitable introduction for the person who remembers it in time. They deserve a little credit before the journey begins.
lore3490_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Make a little room before the grand departure. A bag full of impressive finds can still be missing the small thing you meant to bring. I am happy to supply a suitable introduction for the person who remembers it in time. They deserve a little credit before the journey begins.

lore3490_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [cheerful] You have become someone I am glad to see before I know what you need from the stock. Come along, friend. I would enjoy a little company away from the supplies. I can leave the elaborate introduction behind, though you are welcome to ask for it if the road needs a little ceremony.
lore3490_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am glad to see before I know what you need from the stock. Come along, friend. I would enjoy a little company away from the supplies. I can leave the elaborate introduction behind, though you are welcome to ask for it if the road needs a little ceremony.

lore3490_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [playful] [showman flair] Welcome back, friend. Have you remembered the little things for your next grand undertaking? I keep a number of them here. Candles, seeds, vials, and the rest of the things nobody mentions in the triumphant introduction. I have been working on an introduction that gives their supplier a little more credit.
lore3490_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back, friend. Have you remembered the little things for your next grand undertaking? I keep a number of them here. Candles, seeds, vials, and the rest of the things nobody mentions in the triumphant introduction. I have been working on an introduction that gives their supplier a little more credit.

lore3490_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [lightly theatrical] Travelers arrive with such fine introductions. Great deeds, impressive journeys, enemies defeated. I began making one for myself. Supplier of the remembered candle, keeper of the needed vial... it grows longer whenever I think of something else that helped. I have yet to finish it before a friend starts grinning.
lore3490_idle_1.ogg.text: Travelers arrive with such fine introductions. Great deeds, impressive journeys, enemies defeated. I began making one for myself. Supplier of the remembered candle, keeper of the needed vial... it grows longer whenever I think of something else that helped. I have yet to finish it before a friend starts grinning.

lore3995_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased] [conspiratorial] You have learned the value of waiting for the last word. I enjoy that in company. Stay beside me, mon. An audience that understands the joke is a great improvement over listening to one's own echo.
lore3995_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have learned the value of waiting for the last word. I enjoy that in company. Stay beside me, mon. An audience that understands the joke is a great improvement over listening to one's own echo.

lore3995_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [mischievous] There you are, mon. Come along, and do not speak over the interesting part. Every little pause has its purpose. Sometimes I am thinking. Sometimes I am giving the audience a moment to become properly nervous.
lore3995_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, mon. Come along, and do not speak over the interesting part. Every little pause has its purpose. Sometimes I am thinking. Sometimes I am giving the audience a moment to become properly nervous.

lore3995_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [theatrical] [dryly amused] I once heard my laugh return from the cave at precisely the right moment. Since then, I have been trying to reproduce the effect. The echo has no respect for rehearsal. Or perhaps I began too soon again.
lore3995_idle_1.ogg.text: I once heard my laugh return from the cave at precisely the right moment. Since then, I have been trying to reproduce the effect. The echo has no respect for rehearsal. Or perhaps I began too soon again.

lore3995_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [delighted] [ominous] A careful hand, a good memory, and the ability to count all those eyes. Useful qualities, mon. Now let me attend to the brewing. Stand where you can see, and do try not to interrupt the best part.
lore3995_quest_1.ogg.text: A careful hand, a good memory, and the ability to count all those eyes. Useful qualities, mon. Now let me attend to the brewing. Stand where you can see, and do try not to interrupt the best part.

lore5941_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] Come sit with me when you have a moment, my friend. We can cast a line, skip a few stones, or let the water do all the talking.
lore5941_befriended_1.ogg.text: Come sit with me when you have a moment, my friend. We can cast a line, skip a few stones, or let the water do all the talking.

lore5941_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly] [lighthearted] Good to see you. Bring your patience if we go near the water. Bring a little luck, too. I have a pebble that ought to skip beautifully.
lore5941_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Bring your patience if we go near the water. Bring a little luck, too. I have a pebble that ought to skip beautifully.

lore5941_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [pleased] That was a good flat pebble. Three skips, perhaps four. I am counting the little one at the end. It made an honest effort.
lore5941_idle_1.ogg.text: That was a good flat pebble. Three skips, perhaps four. I am counting the little one at the end. It made an honest effort.

lore5941_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [gentle] There is more to a camp than getting ready for another fight. Put a little joy beside the fire. That is a good reason to learn the Fish Bowl lesson.
lore5941_rest_1.ogg.text: There is more to a camp than getting ready for another fight. Put a little joy beside the fire. That is a good reason to learn the Fish Bowl lesson.

lore6018_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You have shown respect without making a performance of it. I value that. Today I would like your company, and perhaps your answer to a question that has nothing to do with a lesson.
lore6018_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have shown respect without making a performance of it. I value that. Today I would like your company, and perhaps your answer to a question that has nothing to do with a lesson.

lore6018_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured] [warm] You have arrived at just the right time. I heard a riddle at the market, and I would like another answer. Walk with me. There is no ceremony required for this one.
lore6018_greet_1.ogg.text: You have arrived at just the right time. I heard a riddle at the market, and I would like another answer. Walk with me. There is no ceremony required for this one.

lore6018_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [gently amused] A merchant asked a little question between selling two pieces of fruit. I have thought about it longer than several very grand speeches. Wisdom can arrive without announcing all its titles.
lore6018_idle_1.ogg.text: A merchant asked a little question between selling two pieces of fruit. I have thought about it longer than several very grand speeches. Wisdom can arrive without announcing all its titles.

lore6018_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [instructive] Keep what you have learned with care. Understand why you use it, and respect the teaching that brought it to you. A lesson is worth more than the ability to repeat its words.
lore6018_learned_1.ogg.text: Keep what you have learned with care. Understand why you use it, and respect the teaching that brought it to you. A lesson is worth more than the ability to repeat its words.

lore6408_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [pleased] You have made time for more than the work, and I am glad of it. Stay beside me, mon. We can speak of your journeys, or make a little room for something that need not become a great deed at all.
lore6408_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made time for more than the work, and I am glad of it. Stay beside me, mon. We can speak of your journeys, or make a little room for something that need not become a great deed at all.

lore6408_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [serious] [thoughtful] Power is held in things others might overlook. The satyrs take from the forest; my gauntlet work draws upon what their hooves have gathered. Be mindful of what you bring to a crafting, and of the hands that will wear it.
lore6408_gear_1.ogg.text: Power is held in things others might overlook. The satyrs take from the forest; my gauntlet work draws upon what their hooves have gathered. Be mindful of what you bring to a crafting, and of the hands that will wear it.

lore6408_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [unhurried] Good to see you, mon. The spirits may follow your great deeds, but I would like to hear the smaller parts as well. Tell me what pleased you on the way here. There is room in the day for that.
lore6408_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, mon. The spirits may follow your great deeds, but I would like to hear the smaller parts as well. Tell me what pleased you on the way here. There is room in the day for that.

lore6408_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [gentle] A stick, a patch of sand, and a fish with a crooked tail. That is all. No secret message from the spirits. I could straighten it, but then it would look like a fish that already knows where it is going.
